capabilities: display note counts next to folders in the file explorer
count all elements under a folder including sub-folders
show counts for expanded folders via a setting
extras: Counts include all elements under a folder and its sub-folders; by default expanded folders with sub-folders show no count unless a setting is enabled.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer does not show how many notes a folder contains, so you have to count or open folders to gauge their size.
summary: Adds folder note-count badges to the file explorer, including recursive totals across sub-folders.
